programme.title: 万千星辉颁奖典礼2025粤
programme.desc: 《新闻女王2》横扫九个奖项，成2025台庆颁奖礼大赢家。除了囊括香港、大湾区两个剧集奖项，佘诗曼、黄宗泽同封「双料视帝、视后」。何广沛、王敏奕首夺「最佳男、女配角」，由詹天文主唱的电视歌曲亦得奖。「最佳男、女主持」方面，车婉婉爆喊当选，林盛斌激动领奖震撼全场！吴业坤、叶蒨文成功「飞跃」，「男、女新人」则落在冯皓扬、刘洋、倪嘉雯手里。曾志伟荣膺「万千光辉荣誉传奇」，获谭咏麟现身颁奖兼献歌，场面动人！

programme.title: 信辉康养特约︰湾区安老Chill凡体验粤
programme.desc: 选择大湾区安老院舍除了考虑环境和服务，交通及生活配套亦非常重要。今集主持徐荣介绍的一所六星级康养中心，直通巴士站、商场、食肆都近在咫尺，让长者能够享受精彩充实的安老生活。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 苏民峰师傅继续细谈马年生肖运程，属鸡者是好运榜首？狗是重桃花的生肖，但同时要慎防六粒凶星！属猪人士将「表明风光，地位提升」，是好还是坏？年初二，桃李满门的低音大提琴导师，找来四名学生合作演奏中国民谣<凤阳花鼓；其中两位还是其公子，从小就习琴。要学好低音大提琴，时间管理最重要！众学生还分享学习得着，以及出外表演的深刻点滴。「睇𩠌食饭」，潮州菜师傅许美德以龙虾及马蹄，示范贺年菜「龙马精神」。

programme.title: 中年好声音3红白大战粤
programme.desc: 下半场先来「国风对决」，曹越、刘晓昆、陈嘉琦的<糖不甩，穿上戏曲服饰的赵浚承、陆东成等以<新禅院钟声应战。紧接是「四王四后」比拼，两队各派四人模仿九十年代天王、天后，星味十足。善玥澄、刘晓昆、阮慧珊、侯静伊、钟凯莹化身性感女团送上<似火探戈和<烈焰红唇，这场「热舞激战」白队会如何应对？终极回合的「梦想解码」，两队会合力演绎动人舞台剧。另外，陈芷盈、占士丁丁会带来为登峰之战准备的决胜快歌。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子得知中野先生家里冷清，适逢节分来临，便偕同爷爷跑到对方家为其撒豆驱鬼、迎春接福。小丸子为了丰富茶点，决定暂时不用被炉，爷爷带小丸子到房里用火钵取暖煎茶，让她认识到火钵的魅力。

programme.title: 灼热卡巴迪粤日
programme.desc: 宵越和畦道的一年级队，与水澄和伊达的二年级队进行练习比赛，却以大比数差距惨败。虽然宵越对合作感到抗拒，但他深知如要获胜，就必须与畦道建立团队默契。宵越与畦道继而展开秘密特训，向二年级队提出挑战！

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 过农历新年时，总会见到萝卜糕、芋头糕等糕点，原来与同音字「高」有关，寓意地位提升。至于拜年常见的攒盒(全盒)，为何会放入油炸食物及糖渍食物？每一件放进去的东西，即使是不能吃的利是和桔，都别有寓意！对本地文化甚有研究的萧欣浩博士逐一讲解。春节传统习俗上，初三会拜神祈福，初七会庆祝「人日」，背后可有甚么故事？年十五「元宵」亦被称为「中国情人节」，古时男女相聚花灯会互表心意，也会吃象征甜蜜团圆的汤圆。

programme.title: 忍者乱太郎粤日
programme.desc: 雪鬼和雨鬼被其他城堡的忍者招揽过档。新丁出奇地在测验中取得全班最高的分数，但新丁自己也不明白为什么会有这样的成绩。乱太郎他们走捷径返回忍术学校，途中意外发现了一间大屋及形迹可疑的人。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 利嘉阁地产45 周年真盘源特约：今日有楼睇粤 及 信辉康养特约︰湾区安老Chill凡体验粤
programme.desc: 长沙湾有新盘一房，洗衣机喉管漏水浸湿地台，洗手间柜底也堆积垃圾，为何如此？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 世界观粤 及 天气报告粤
东张西望粤
programme.desc: 有巴士乘客坐车期间，车长突然把车内灯全关掉，使其行程沦为「暗黑」车程。随机街访巴士司机，表示这做法有违公司指引。新一年最好财源广进，同时亦要小心避免给予骗徒发财机会！有市民加入投资群组赚了一小笔利润，不断被游说注资，想退出却被要求罚款，否则会被告上法庭，兼终身剥夺其政治权利？亦有市民接陌生电话指保险过期需罚款，事主跟从「职员」指示输入五位数字去取消「扣保险费」，户口终被扣款五位数！

programme.title: 香港赛马会呈献:「马到功成耀香江」马年烟花汇演粤
programme.desc: 2026马年烟花汇演于大年初二(1月18日)晚上八时，在维多利亚港上空举行。本年新春烟花汇演主题是「马到功成耀香江」，共分八幕，总共发放31,888枚烟花。除了首幕《骏马启程》有15秒高密度开幕烟花与礼花弹层层推进，营造骏马初出、万马奔腾的形象之外，历时23分钟的汇演还可看到「8」字型、金元宝图案、星光、大锦冠的耀目烟花效果。节目直击烟花璀璨的盛况，和香港民众一起感受春节热闹气氛，共同欢度新岁。

programme.title: 非常检控观#22粤PG
programme.desc: 希仁获挽留，得以检控庞喆，颂星引咎辞职。庞喆设法自救，讵料……子廉猝逝，其父赵德贤的前妻李妃宸携子赵子礼回来，认回德贤。子礼行山失踪，后被发现尸体，熊飞展开调查。善昱取得庞喆的股权，有意成为集团主席的接任人。妃宸告知希仁与熊飞，子礼与她及德贤竟无血缘关系，怀疑当年人工受孕过程中出错！子帧被要求过继给德贤，以成为集团继承人，他惊觉德敬并非全无野心，担心德敬为让他成为接班人而犯错，公孙珀劝他查明真相。

programme.title: 欢乐茶饭#14粤普PG
programme.desc: 韶光拒绝了柳丰的求亲；韶光向林晏提及关于洗碗机的事，没想到他竟然真的造了出来；林晏使计令长公主交出尺牍，亦让赵王发现林晏开始对自己起疑；林晏打算为崔家平反后，就向韶光提亲；沈家迎来在永安的第一场雪…

programme.title: 香港欧化飞鹰活络油呈献：一马当先行大运粤
programme.desc: 大年初二，玲玲师傅相约洪天明、周家蔚夫妇同吃开年饭。天明细谈父亲洪金宝坚持传统礼节，晚辈要向长辈跪拜敬茶贺年，并透露父亲望添一名孙女，遂向师傅探问玄机。碧霞师傅称家中门口忌放雨伞、鞋等，即使挥春亦只宜贴至正月十五？丞丞师傅与展望、蒨文新春行大运游览佛山三水，了解魁岗文塔的历史及风水故事，还尝试用葱、芹、粽子祈福的当地习俗。云文子师傅带来2026年猫狗催运贴士；还有元海伉俪送上马年家居旺位布阵锦囊。

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#3粤
programme.desc: 元宗与严平两败俱伤，善柔杀严平取其头胪领赏金。元宗临终送木剑及钜子令给少龙。少龙责善柔见利忘义害死元宗，愤然离去。少龙误打误撞助灰胡擒乌氏家将陶方及大小姐乌廷芳，原来灰胡是马贼及受雇夺取和氏璧，少龙使计助陶方及廷芳逃走，得知和氏璧用来交换秦质子嬴政，答应替陶方取回。灰胡的雇主取得和氏璧后杀人灭口，陶方推测此人是赵国巨鹿侯赵穆的手下连晋，二人跟踪连晋，惊见他打造假和氏璧及杀工匠灭口。

programme.title: 康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#4粤
programme.desc: 少龙见连晋欲私吞和氏璧，使计将真假和氏璧调包。陶方带少龙回乌家堡拜会主人乌应元，廷芳不满少龙诋毁连晋。连晋将假和氏璧交给赵穆，少龙在赵王面前略施小计即令乌家脱罪，赵穆暗气。少龙不值王妹赵雅之子赵盘欺负少女，仗义教训之。少龙随应元入宫饮宴，被一美宫女吸引。原来她是廷芳好友公主赵倩。赵穆与少龙、应元为应否放嬴政母子返秦争拗，赵穆乘机怂恿少龙与连晋在御前比剑，连晋应战挥剑劈向少龙的脑门。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粤
programme.desc: 斋是农历新年的常见菜式，本集Gigi姐会示范烹煮现代版本，例如以前的斋是有发菜的，但现在因为保护环境而不会再用。而传统的斋总给人油腻的感觉，Gigi姐教大家挑选比较健康又耐热的油，最适合用来做这道斋。

programme.title: 鼎爷做节攻略粤
programme.desc: 鼎爷以樱花虾、梅菜、五花腩、豆腐四种简单食材炮制出宴客佳肴。留意咸梅菜与甜梅菜的比例，切碎后以白镬烘干，然后与五花腩拌匀舖在豆腐上蒸熟，最后淋上泡油后的樱花虾是精粹所在！紧接鼎爷制作「黄金豆腐」，豆腐先浸在卤水中至入味，切粒后蘸脆浆炸香，配上XO酱同吃别有一番风味。以鸡入馔可谓过节必备，鼎爷特以鸡项制作「葱油鸡」。留意蒸鸡方法，鸡只蒸好后斩件，接着淋上文火炸香的葱油，葱香配嫩滑鸡肉味道一流！

programme.desc: 「香港鬼才」黄沾为乐坛留下大量优秀的音乐作品，首首歌曲都耐人寻味，区瑞强、林一峰、林二汶、杜丽莎、李龙基、胡琳、袁丽嫦，以及沾叔第一任妻子华娃，分别演绎沾叔创作的经典歌曲。主持人则论尽沾叔的传奇往事。

programme.title: 双祥见粤
programme.desc: 双祥大整贺年食物-年糕及萝卜糕，一于祝节目收视步步高升，亦由此引申到圈中艺人平步青云、步步高升的幸运例子。

programme.title: 双祥见粤
programme.desc: 双祥准备了丰富食材，为大家整大吉大利贺年盘菜，二人更分享拍摄群戏时鲜为人知的幕后趣事！

programme.title: 鼎爷做节攻略粤
programme.desc: 鼎爷以樱花虾、梅菜、五花腩、豆腐四种简单食材炮制出宴客佳肴。留意咸梅菜与甜梅菜的比例，切碎后以白镬烘干，然后与五花腩拌匀舖在豆腐上蒸熟，最后淋上泡油后的樱花虾是精粹所在！紧接鼎爷制作「黄金豆腐」，豆腐先浸在卤水中至入味，切粒后蘸脆浆炸香，配上XO酱同吃别有一番风味。以鸡入馔可谓过节必备，鼎爷特以鸡项制作「葱油鸡」。留意蒸鸡方法，鸡只蒸好后斩件，接着淋上文火炸香的葱油，葱香配嫩滑鸡肉味道一流！

programme.title: 2025香港小姐竞选决赛粤
programme.desc: 张敬轩以美妙歌声揭开本届决赛序幕，十四位准港姐闪耀登场。佳丽才艺比拼，现代舞、古筝、花式跳绳、艺术体操、Rap唱够惊艳；紧接配合李治廷的歌声奉上缤纷Catwalk演出，并诉说梦想中的无限可能。十强佳丽晋身「海底世界」，在泳装答问环节展口才和美态，再于卫兰靓声引领下漫游「童话仙境」，还有邝美云献声助兴。五强终极拉票，最终陈咏诗冠军加冕，施宇琪、袁文静分获亚、季军，李尹嫣则成「最上镜小姐兼友谊小姐」。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 大年初三，苏民峰师傅继续亮相节目，为属鼠、属牛、属虎的观众带来马年生肖运程。预测涵盖事业、爱情、健康等范畴，并提出建议锦囊，据说其中一个生肖在这年有机会财源滚滚！中式书法多以平面呈现，有艺术家尝试将传统书法立体化，希望做到一笔一划皆可观赏，既具美感又保留书意。艺术家到临细谈从陶泥、木材到铁材的制字经历，并展示以铁材制成的字雕塑作品，分享创作心得。「睇𩠌食饭」环节，傅季馨示范「日系山椒南瓜鸡肉煮」。

programme.title: 一班好声音「十」力无限演唱会粤
programme.desc: 十位「中一生」发放「火热动感」，更无惧突破。李佳、罗启豪、颜志恒、林鉫徫无伴奏打造<天梯；龙婷、支喾仪韩风舞动<失忆周末。丁文俊、魏嘉信操肌特训玩<脱掉；吴大强逆龄伙拍支支Rap唱<系咁先啦。周吉佩除挑战拉丁舞，与志恒、嘉信跳唱<忘情森巴舞时，还获各自爱妻伴舞。「中二四大天王」献声撑场，玩转<广播道Fans杀人事件。回望好声音追梦之旅，中一生<不再犹豫，也对支持者呼喊<无言感激！

programme.title: 灼热卡巴迪粤日
programme.desc: 宵越一边练习一边摸索「胜利」的路径，反而愈来愈焦躁，井浦见状，便建议宵越发展自身优势，成为最强突袭者。数天后，宵越跑步时意外撞倒一个完全没有气息的瘦弱男子，而此人的真实身份竟是……

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 农历新年期间，大家享用了不少高热量的贺年美食，是时候跟随「WORKOUT 2GETHER」锻练，保持身体健康。基础体适能训练中，波比跳、原地跳等动作都需连续做出，玲玲姐姐完成后直言有点气喘，但教练提醒，唯有达至这强度才可有效促进新陈代谢。接着还会利用阻力带强化肌力，针对手臂、大腿、腹部进行锻练，有甚么相关动作？本集亦带来AI生成动画《年兽的故事》下半部，究竟留在村中的伯伯将如何对付凶猛的年兽？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粤日
programme.desc: 正当阳葵三人分享赢得美人鱼大赛造型的喜悦之际，阳葵想到一个疑问，就是每次大赛的奖品，到底是由谁人挑选。根据四眼姐姐说法，这是「委员会」的工作。而委员会的成员，就是DJ荷特、史派西P与马卡龙女士三人。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 新闻掏宝粤
programme.desc: 常言道：「今日新闻，明日历史」。每天那么多新闻，大家可能来不及消化，更遑论回望历史。历史就是一个大宝库，少看历史和小看历史，很容易「走宝」。新节目《新闻掏宝》带大家在宝库「掏」新闻宝藏，除了昔日特辑、直播和系列报道，还有从未曝光的珍贵片段，观众有机会重温李小龙出殡、宝生银行劫案、四人帮审讯、英女王访港、的士罢驶、中英签订联合声明、戴卓尔夫人专访、越南难民、尤德逝世、彭定康抵港、启德机场关闭、邓小平逝世、九七回归大典、华航香港空难和沙士记者会。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2747粤
programme.desc: 过年前，树根向街坊邻里「挑起事端」，原来另有图谋。因树根之故，城安的利是收入大减，需要设法增加「进账」。熊家的亲戚大多移居海外，城安向三舅公越洋拜年，成功讨得利是，却令树根大破悭囊。不少海外亲戚欲向树根越洋拜年，城安想到一个「低成本」派利是的解决方法，讵料……大四喜出埠表演，当地却因某些原因禁止新年习俗。其后，城安致电树根，称海外一众亲戚亲身前来要向树根拜年，提醒树根切勿回来……

programme.title: 非常检控观#23粤PG
programme.desc: 希仁找到为妃宸进行人工受孕的生殖学家程国揆。国揆是赵舟的好友，提到自己早已认识希仁……妃宸怀疑人工受孕出错是赵舟指使，希仁往找赵舟对质！善昱找庞喆，商量如何争夺庆历；子帧意外发现身世有可疑，向德敬问明真相。熊飞搜集赵舟陷害妃宸的证据，胚胎学家钱艺珠此时打算离港。逸桐发现义兄们往生殖医学中心纵火，通知熊飞阻止，自己亦身陷险境……希仁试探国揆，国揆招认过错，并说出令希仁震惊的真相！

programme.title: 欢乐茶饭#15粤普
programme.desc: 沈家人发现韶光与林晏互生情愫，决意搬走。林晏问韶光为何躲著自己，韶光的违心话让他黯然神伤。韶杰因牙人酷似前妻而被骗钱，因此大受刺激。曹融发现或有许多兵卒假死，赵荀之牵扯其中，林晏决定悄悄接近查探。

programme.title: 香港欧化飞鹰活络油呈献：一马当先行大运粤
programme.desc: 年初三「赤口」，丞丞师傅带展望、蒨文到访肇庆悦城的龙母祖庙，并细述龙母的传说故事。据称摸龙母床可保祐生育，有何宜忌？风水玄学认为家居隐藏病位，枫燧师傅分享其检测病位「法宝」及化解布阵。玲玲师傅率众游逛深圳的花卉小镇，细谈买年花、养鱼、摆放植物的心得，提醒忌于电脑旁放多肉盆栽？想添新年财，碧霞师傅推荐其「心水」旺财投注地区，以及幸运号码与颜色。女士如想招桃花，云文子师傅有其喷香水玄学见解，可供参考。

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#5粤
programme.desc: 赵穆责连晋没趁机杀少龙。应元见少龙蹴鞠的球技了得，请他训练家将，廷芳及其兄廷威均不满。廷芳叫连晋买药教训少龙，连晋却买下毒药给她。少龙夜探质子府遇陶方，少龙讹称是秦相吕不韦派来的密探。少龙挑选精英以训练蹴鞠为名，实则训练拯救赢政的死士。廷芳在少龙的肉汤下药，意外打翻，小狗舐吃后毒发身亡，廷芳质问连晋，连晋巧言脱罪。廷芳与廷威硬要加入蹴鞠训练队伍，少龙遂与廷芳打赌。廷芳入宫探望赵倩，大数少龙的不是。

programme.title: 康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#6粤
programme.desc: 廷芳完成考核，要少龙跳崖，少龙即纵身跳下，廷芳大惊。廷芳被少龙所骗，大骂他「衰人」。少龙以现代踢足球方法教众人蹴鞠，廷芳与廷威表怀疑。比赛日，赵盘及王子赵嘉打赌。盘母赵雅令众生倾倒，公子赵德嘲笑赵盘有名风骚娘亲，赵盘愤怒。少龙等节节领先，连晋偷袭，少龙借口受伤出，与陶方赶往质子府救人遭埋伏，并赫见善柔。赵穆借问候少龙伤势到乌家查探，幸少龙早有对策。廷芳偷听少龙与应元等对话，惊悉秘密，对少龙改观。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粤
programme.desc: 唔玩唔知身体好，唔测唔知时运高。陈嘉桓、连诗雅用求签方式配对队员后，进行连串「身体检查游戏」。气球及石春路结合，证实连诗雅很久没有夜蒲，亦看出张振朗、何浩文身体不济。牙膏放在地上任踩，有人声势大却得低分数，甚至有负分出现！张振朗跳群体竹舞时两度连累队友，还高呼错不在他！罪魁祸首是甚么？何君诚及何浩文头戴VR眼镜玩平衡木，当中有人极度畏高，甚至飙冷汗！出线一队向许愿树抛橙，神明会否保佑他们收到礼物？

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
喜羊羊与灰太狼之飞马奇遇记粤
交易现场粤 及 信辉康养特约︰湾区安老Chill凡体验粤
鼎爷做节攻略粤
programme.desc: 猪油、鸡油适合用来炮制不同食材，鼎爷起镬制油，奉上两道不一样的滋味。「蟹粉肉丝炒年糕」的灵魂在于大闸蟹，拣选时有何贴士？猪肉眼扒口感嫩滑，加上甘香丰腴的蟹粉，味道层次进一步提升。上海年糕下镬兜炒前，又要怎样处理？刺身级西班牙红虾可以生吃，下镬烹调亦不宜过熟。鼎爷煎香原只红虾，再用虾头、虾壳煮出香浓虾汁。陈村粉先用XO酱调味，蒸熟后再淋上鸡油、虾汁，味道更香滑。阿谭「出手」享用红虾，吮出啖啖鲜味！

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 苏民峰谈马年生肖运程来到尾声，苏师傅提到属兔者于2026遇上财运年，而且桃花亦厉害？属龙人士纵然平稳，但也有三个吉星。属蛇者去年犯太岁，待农历四月后可望否极泰来，同时迎接雾水桃花。「笑一笑，世界更美妙」，爱笑瑜伽导师指出多笑对健康甚有作用，并带领主持、学员一同示范爱笑瑜伽基本功，最好由「扮笑」开始？接着的动作还注入新年元素，配合贺年气氛！「睇𩠌食饭」，Annie藉「金沙百花球」祝观众马年金银满屋！

programme.title: 一条麻甩在广州粤
programme.desc: 广州，粤菜发源地之一，广府菜的中心，是每一位食客都无法拒绝的美食圣地。爱吃爱玩的主持人麦包，在广州彻底释放了吃货天性，走遍大街小巷，寻找地道美食：悠闲早茶、西关小吃、新潮佳馔，夜市小摊

programme.title: 单恋双城#13粤
programme.desc: 式适求元山被赶，但恭梓解决了元山问题，助式适说服他再次带团。Marco想找恭梓作曲。禛加入榴梿炮制鸡蛋仔得钱进大赞，欲制作榴梿小圆饼参赛。专荣忘记结婚周年纪念，书舒发现丈夫的婚戒不见了，痛骂后赶走他。

programme.title: 灼热卡巴迪粤日
programme.desc: 王城向宵越诉说他的目标，就是与伙伴携手胜出，成为日本第一的卡巴迪队伍。他认为宵越亟需实战经验，于是火速安排了一场练习赛。对手是由王城旧友六弦歩领军，兼且坐拥王牌高谷炼的关东四强，奏和高中。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 马年初四，插画师子健哥哥到来「Artspiration」，教大家用画笔呈献一只活力十足的贺年小骏马。波浪形鬃毛、跃起姿势都是绘画重点，还要为其「穿上」中式拜年新衣，再以几项贺年装饰作点缀，添上新春气氛。炮仗可怎样画？适逢过年，一众小朋友都有万样欢乐事想「开心Share」。有小朋友分享每年办年货的「策略」，主持们则聊起行花市的经历。提到贺年糕点，大家又爱吃甚么款式？另有小朋友带来在内地放烟花的片段。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粤日
programme.desc: 阿樱找上阳葵，查看偶像公主手环的情况。阳葵的手环是Priverse公司交托予学生会特别型号，现在却只有阳葵能驾驭它，阿樱一直都想解开这个谜团。在交谈途中，阿樱还说起了，学生会就是因为偶像公主手环而走在一起。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 利嘉阁地产45 周年真盘源特约：今日有楼睇粤 及 信辉康养特约︰湾区安老Chill凡体验粤
programme.desc: 屯门一个村屋单位，已居住多年，设计师如何调动间隔，令空间划分更理想？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 世界观粤 及 天气报告粤
东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2748粤
programme.desc: 雷公向敢威追讨欠款，并以敢威承诺偿还债务的录音为凭证，扬言采取法律行动。敢威起初对自己曾说过这些话毫无印象，力莲等人彻查亦无所得，敢威后来才记起醉酒时与雷公打赌的经过。纵使敢威愿意还钱，但雷公拒收，似乎另有目的。敢威遂找虹豆沙汤远调停，沙汤远提出特别方法尝试解决纷争，却事与愿违。其后，雷公「出招搞事」，令接龙声誉受损，敢威只好设法应对。最终，敢威为平息风波，答应了雷公提出的要求……

programme.title: 非常检控观#24粤PG
programme.desc: (大结局)赵舟涉嫌买凶纵火被捕。熊飞翻查子礼出事地点，发现不妥……善昱公开子帧身世，欲夺庆历主席之位。国揆约希仁到教堂见面，泰巨挟持善昱到来，希仁镜反射泰巨的毒瘾，不能自控……希仁自认杀害国揆，善昱亦指证他。善昱召开董事会，要求取消主席由嫡长子优先继承的制度……颂星等人设法要说服希仁放弃认罪；众人于教堂发现新线索……泰巨挟持善昱逃亡，熊飞展开追捕，险象环生！法庭上，颂星为希仁辩护……

programme.title: 香港欧化飞鹰活络油呈献：一马当先行大运粤
programme.desc: 支喾仪开设的烘焙店已冲出香港，适宜向美加发展吗？有请玲玲师傅赐教，师傅还提到其命盘有名气运，连带是非亦较多。丞丞师傅偕展望、蒨文往广州的黄大仙祠参拜，并细说其历史故事。俞可程2025年连环遇上不幸事，包括驾车发生意外，她载碧霞师傅重返现场，察看可有不妥……大大个卦象图摆办公室，想利事业恐惹上司讨厌？勤龙师傅建议可用AI生成画像，将上、下卦分别化为动物、自然景象。另有璞初师傅细谈何谓「旗鼓八阵法」。

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 天气报告粤 及 信辉康养特约︰湾区安老Chill凡体验粤
康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#7粤
programme.desc: 赵穆从连晋口中得知少龙好女色，心生一计。少龙在市集为赵雅制服癫马后，觉事有蹊跷。少龙送廷芳玉簪，廷芳暗喜，但当知赵雅约会少龙，愤而掷簪，少龙拾断簪拂袖而去。赵雅对少龙百般挑逗，赵盘闯入指骂二人荡妇淫贼，赵雅怒掴之。赵雅醉倒，对少龙没有乘人之危深表欣赏；廷芳妒火中烧。少龙遭刺杀时善柔出现救他，少龙责她助纣为虐，善柔反斥他不知感恩。赵穆怒责连晋派人杀少龙全为了廷芳。少龙应赵雅之约往赏花，廷芳打翻醋酲。

programme.title: 康业信贷快递呈献：寻秦记#8粤
programme.desc: 赵穆以美人、大屋拉拢，少龙不为所动。廷芳无意中打破赵雅送给少龙的兰花，向赵倩索新兰花作赔偿，赵倩透露将远嫁韩或魏国。赵雅要赵盘拜少龙为师，赵盘不屑，少龙露一手令赵盘甘心拜师。陶方指著廷芳所送兰花，暗示廷芳喜欢少龙，少龙苦恼。赵穆直指少龙是外国奸细，又指少龙的锦盒内藏通敌密函。少龙在赵雅府重遇赵倩，误会她是小宫女。赵盘使用墨子剑法令赵德跪地求饶，引得神秘人注视。少龙被神秘人跟踪，二人大打出手。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 苏民峰谈马年生肖运程来到尾声，苏师傅提到属兔者于2026遇上财运年，而且桃花亦厉害？属龙人士纵然平稳，但也有三个吉星。属蛇者去年犯太岁，待农历四月后可望否极泰来，同时迎接雾水桃花。「笑一笑，世界更美妙」，爱笑瑜伽导师指出多笑对健康甚有作用，并带领主持、学员一同示范爱笑瑜伽基本功，最好由「扮笑」开始？接着的动作还注入新年元素，配合贺年气氛！「睇𩠌食饭」，Annie藉「金沙百花球」祝观众马年金银满屋！

programme.title: 鼎爷做节攻略粤
programme.desc: 猪油、鸡油适合用来炮制不同食材，鼎爷起镬制油，奉上两道不一样的滋味。「蟹粉肉丝炒年糕」的灵魂在于大闸蟹，拣选时有何贴士？猪肉眼扒口感嫩滑，加上甘香丰腴的蟹粉，味道层次进一步提升。上海年糕下镬兜炒前，又要怎样处理？刺身级西班牙红虾可以生吃，下镬烹调亦不宜过熟。鼎爷煎香原只红虾，再用虾头、虾壳煮出香浓虾汁。陈村粉先用XO酱调味，蒸熟后再淋上鸡油、虾汁，味道更香滑。阿谭「出手」享用红虾，吮出啖啖鲜味！

programme.title: 一条麻甩在广州粤
programme.desc: 广州，粤菜发源地之一，广府菜的中心，是每一位食客都无法拒绝的美食圣地。爱吃爱玩的主持人麦包，在广州彻底释放了吃货天性，走遍大街小巷，寻找地道美食：悠闲早茶、西关小吃、新潮佳馔，夜市小摊

programme.title: 单恋双城#13粤
programme.desc: 式适求元山被赶，但恭梓解决了元山问题，助式适说服他再次带团。Marco想找恭梓作曲。禛加入榴梿炮制鸡蛋仔得钱进大赞，欲制作榴梿小圆饼参赛。专荣忘记结婚周年纪念，书舒发现丈夫的婚戒不见了，痛骂后赶走他。

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 点心、茶、茶楼有何相关歇后语？郑宝鸿细谈昔日「饮茶」掌故，还讲解「单料铜煲」、「混吉」的出处。主持们到访刀具店、旗袍店与影楼，实地了解与刀、布、摄影器材等有关的歇后语。廖舜禧带来「唔使问阿贵」的典故。

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 主持在花墟测试街坊对植物、交通、金钱相关歇后语的认识；及后前往粥店与饼家，探索「亚茂整饼」等与美食有关歇后语。郑宝鸿细说「陆荣庭睇相」出处。廖舜禧带来「牛o赵牡丹」的「o赵」、「笋盘」的「笋」正写。

programme.title: 猪猪侠之超星五灵侠S1
programme.desc: 猪猪侠与同伴接收到来自九霄星的求救信号，尽管他们已经失去了强大的超能力，但热心肠的猪猪们仍然义无反顾地再次启航，前往那个充满未知数的陌生星球。来到九霄星后，猪猪们看到了整个星球的地表都被灼热的岩浆覆盖，而空中竟然悬浮着许多壮观宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，这些天空之城正在陆续失去能让它们悬浮的五灵元素，面临坠毁的威胁。猪猪侠等人寻找背后的原因，并耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪恶力量，使出浑身解数拯救天空之城。一场守护正义、保护天空之城的全新冒险之旅开始啦。

programme.title: 陷入纯情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成郑敬淏爱与复仇的心脏奇迹】没血没泪的冷酷企业代表姜敏浩，有著先天扩张性心藏病，面对随时有可能死亡的恐惧感，做起事来比谁都还心狠手辣。幼年父亲去世时，叔叔夺走了父亲的公司，高层主管们也纷纷选择背叛，庞大压力下母亲选择轻生留下敏浩一人。复仇心的驱使下，他成为GoldPartners的投资专家，同时也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大债权人团体，看似成功之际，却心脏病发命在旦夕，所幸出现心脏捐赠者，重生的他因细胞记忆而变得温暖，甚至对仇人女儿产生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的疗愈爱情故事。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高银与朴海镇领衔，知名主角群展现校园青春浪漫！！】大学新生洪雪面对完美又腹黑的刘正学长，因独特魅力逐渐受他吸引。随著两人情意渐浓，刘正的神秘性个性和控制欲逐渐浮出水面，两人微妙的心理战，以及性格不羁同学的白仁浩再洪雪身边守候，三人的矛盾、最终洪雪情归何处?

programme.title: 韩国小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李圣旻社区大叔们联手打造韩国小姐】高中时自恃美貌过人，而没有好好念书的吴智英，毕业后凭借外表当上百货的电梯小姐，看似光鲜亮丽的工作，背后隐藏著许多辛酸，面对毛手毛脚的变态上司，以及百货种种不合理的工作规定，年纪增长且缺乏竞争力另吴智英后悔莫及，偶然的机会下，与现职化妆品公司社长的前男友相遇，公司即将倒闭的金亨俊，与债主郑先生一同把平凡女孩打造为顶级韩国小姐的励志故事。

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 女王之家(完)
programme.desc: 【心机渣男出轨妻子闺蜜为夺下豪门不择手段！】人人称羡的模范夫妻申明燮与韩善珠，在纪念婚礼当天揭开了幸福假象。出身豪门的善珠外表完美，内心却藏著被背叛的恐惧；出身贫寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻转人生却陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美罗，不仅成为他的灵魂寄托，更在命运的捉弄下与善珠结为好友。当真相逐步揭开，爱与恨、正宫与小三的界线逐渐模糊，一场婚礼，也预告了一场悲剧的开始。

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 现在开始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操纵幻术的魔术师朴海镇×通灵女警秦基周，灵异喜剧Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔术师车次雄，不仅能操纵幻术，还能使唤鬼魂，这群「幽灵助手」是他的得力伙伴。热血女警高瑟海，拥有通灵能力，她对灵异现象毫不畏惧。两人因一起调查超自然案件而结盟，一边与鬼神合作，一边大展魔术与正义力量。当喜剧、灵异与调查结合，爱情与真相也心动牵引。

programme.title: 落花时节又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋强撩告白高冷花神刘学义，大谈反差萌恋！！】不懂情爱、呆萌率直的小花妖红凝，为了报恩误闯仙界，却意外发现自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身为花神的锦绣。红凝大胆示爱，直言想当锦绣的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡觉就是要陪他洗澡，让这位必须断情绝爱、恪守仙妖界限的未来天帝继承者瞬间乱了方寸。

programme.title: 监狱医生
programme.desc: 【《千元律师》南宫珉恶斗《车贞淑医生》金炳哲，权贵复仇大秀帝王级演技！！】出身无名大学的罗以载，原为大学医院急诊中心的王牌，因医疗事故而吊销医生执照，重新考取医生执照并申请到监狱医疗科，开始进行复仇之路，成为监狱的医疗科长并成功掌握了名门大学医院理事会。真实体现没有自己不沾血就能打赢的战争。

programme.title: 小欢喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龙！都会家庭的高考大作战】以三个家庭为主轴，方圆和童文洁一家三口，他们的儿子方一凡即将面临高考，但父母的压力与儿子的无忧形成鲜明对比，使得家庭关系逐渐紧张。另一方面，单亲妈妈宋倩与女儿乔英子的生活也充满了挑战，前夫的纠缠和女儿的叛逆让她左右为难。最后，季杨杨从小被寄养在舅舅家，父母突然的关怀让他陷入矛盾，父亲季胜利努力与他建立亲子关系，但结果并不理想。这些家庭的故事交织在一起，展现了现代都市生活中家庭、亲情和成长的种种困境和温暖时刻。

programme.title: 猪猪侠之超星五灵侠S1
programme.desc: 猪猪侠与同伴接收到来自九霄星的求救信号，尽管他们已经失去了强大的超能力，但热心肠的猪猪们仍然义无反顾地再次启航，前往那个充满未知数的陌生星球。来到九霄星后，猪猪们看到了整个星球的地表都被灼热的岩浆覆盖，而空中竟然悬浮着许多壮观宏大、各具特色的天空之城。但是，这些天空之城正在陆续失去能让它们悬浮的五灵元素，面临坠毁的威胁。猪猪侠等人寻找背后的原因，并耍起功夫，抵抗反派邪恶力量，使出浑身解数拯救天空之城。一场守护正义、保护天空之城的全新冒险之旅开始啦。

programme.title: 陷入纯情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成郑敬淏爱与复仇的心脏奇迹】没血没泪的冷酷企业代表姜敏浩，有著先天扩张性心藏病，面对随时有可能死亡的恐惧感，做起事来比谁都还心狠手辣。幼年父亲去世时，叔叔夺走了父亲的公司，高层主管们也纷纷选择背叛，庞大压力下母亲选择轻生留下敏浩一人。复仇心的驱使下，他成为GoldPartners的投资专家，同时也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大债权人团体，看似成功之际，却心脏病发命在旦夕，所幸出现心脏捐赠者，重生的他因细胞记忆而变得温暖，甚至对仇人女儿产生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的疗愈爱情故事。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高银与朴海镇领衔，知名主角群展现校园青春浪漫！！】大学新生洪雪面对完美又腹黑的刘正学长，因独特魅力逐渐受他吸引。随著两人情意渐浓，刘正的神秘性个性和控制欲逐渐浮出水面，两人微妙的心理战，以及性格不羁同学的白仁浩再洪雪身边守候，三人的矛盾、最终洪雪情归何处?

programme.title: 韩国小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李圣旻社区大叔们联手打造韩国小姐】高中时自恃美貌过人，而没有好好念书的吴智英，毕业后凭借外表当上百货的电梯小姐，看似光鲜亮丽的工作，背后隐藏著许多辛酸，面对毛手毛脚的变态上司，以及百货种种不合理的工作规定，年纪增长且缺乏竞争力另吴智英后悔莫及，偶然的机会下，与现职化妆品公司社长的前男友相遇，公司即将倒闭的金亨俊，与债主郑先生一同把平凡女孩打造为顶级韩国小姐的励志故事。

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 只属于我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律师劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆袭成知名设计师】恩静与律师姜胜宰结婚后，原以为会享受奢华生活，但现实却是在婆家被当成佣人使唤。婆婆因恩静没有家世而感到丢脸，胜宰也渐渐冷淡，甚至不愿承认老婆。事实上，恩静发现胜宰根本没有办理结婚登记，当她为了帮助妹妹处理财务问题，办理贷款时才揭露了这个真相。不久后她发现老公与BJ集团继承人有染，决心离开伤心地，重返职场成为知名设计师。与此同时，昔日男友俊夏重新进入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能给她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奶酪陷阱
programme.desc: 【金高银与朴海镇领衔，知名主角群展现校园青春浪漫！！】大学新生洪雪面对完美又腹黑的刘正学长，因独特魅力逐渐受他吸引。随著两人情意渐浓，刘正的神秘性个性和控制欲逐渐浮出水面，两人微妙的心理战，以及性格不羁同学的白仁浩再洪雪身边守候，三人的矛盾、最终洪雪情归何处?

programme.title: 陷入纯情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成郑敬淏爱与复仇的心脏奇迹】没血没泪的冷酷企业代表姜敏浩，有著先天扩张性心藏病，面对随时有可能死亡的恐惧感，做起事来比谁都还心狠手辣。幼年父亲去世时，叔叔夺走了父亲的公司，高层主管们也纷纷选择背叛，庞大压力下母亲选择轻生留下敏浩一人。复仇心的驱使下，他成为GoldPartners的投资专家，同时也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大债权人团体，看似成功之际，却心脏病发命在旦夕，所幸出现心脏捐赠者，重生的他因细胞记忆而变得温暖，甚至对仇人女儿产生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的疗愈爱情故事。

programme.title: 韩国小姐
programme.desc: 【2023百想最佳男主角李圣旻社区大叔们联手打造韩国小姐】高中时自恃美貌过人，而没有好好念书的吴智英，毕业后凭借外表当上百货的电梯小姐，看似光鲜亮丽的工作，背后隐藏著许多辛酸，面对毛手毛脚的变态上司，以及百货种种不合理的工作规定，年纪增长且缺乏竞争力另吴智英后悔莫及，偶然的机会下，与现职化妆品公司社长的前男友相遇，公司即将倒闭的金亨俊，与债主郑先生一同把平凡女孩打造为顶级韩国小姐的励志故事。

programme.title: 现在开始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操纵幻术的魔术师朴海镇×通灵女警秦基周，灵异喜剧Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔术师车次雄，不仅能操纵幻术，还能使唤鬼魂，这群「幽灵助手」是他的得力伙伴。热血女警高瑟海，拥有通灵能力，她对灵异现象毫不畏惧。两人因一起调查超自然案件而结盟，一边与鬼神合作，一边大展魔术与正义力量。当喜剧、灵异与调查结合，爱情与真相也心动牵引。

programme.title: 监狱医生
programme.desc: 【《千元律师》南宫珉恶斗《车贞淑医生》金炳哲，权贵复仇大秀帝王级演技！！】出身无名大学的罗以载，原为大学医院急诊中心的王牌，因医疗事故而吊销医生执照，重新考取医生执照并申请到监狱医疗科，开始进行复仇之路，成为监狱的医疗科长并成功掌握了名门大学医院理事会。真实体现没有自己不沾血就能打赢的战争。

programme.title: 落花时节又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋强撩告白高冷花神刘学义，大谈反差萌恋！！】不懂情爱、呆萌率直的小花妖红凝，为了报恩误闯仙界，却意外发现自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身为花神的锦绣。红凝大胆示爱，直言想当锦绣的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡觉就是要陪他洗澡，让这位必须断情绝爱、恪守仙妖界限的未来天帝继承者瞬间乱了方寸。

programme.title: 小欢喜
programme.desc: 【望子成龙！都会家庭的高考大作战】以三个家庭为主轴，方圆和童文洁一家三口，他们的儿子方一凡即将面临高考，但父母的压力与儿子的无忧形成鲜明对比，使得家庭关系逐渐紧张。另一方面，单亲妈妈宋倩与女儿乔英子的生活也充满了挑战，前夫的纠缠和女儿的叛逆让她左右为难。最后，季杨杨从小被寄养在舅舅家，父母突然的关怀让他陷入矛盾，父亲季胜利努力与他建立亲子关系，但结果并不理想。这些家庭的故事交织在一起，展现了现代都市生活中家庭、亲情和成长的种种困境和温暖时刻。

programme.title: Wanted Dead Or Alive
programme.desc: This movie features a character who is supposed to be the descendant of the character played Steve McQueen in the television series of the same name. programme.title: From Hell To Victory
programme.desc: On August 24, 1939, at a small French cafe, six friends are about to go their separate ways. They vow to reunite on that day each year at the cafe. The film follows each of their lives: one begins work with the French resistance, one joins the French commandos, another is forced to join the Nazi army, one becomes a flier, and the two others are just simple officers. On the day Paris is liberated, the three surviving friends meet at the cafe and get drunk.

programme.title: Baby Einstein - Baby's First Sounds: Discoveries for Little Ears
programme.desc: Perhaps the sweetest sounds you'll ever hear are the babbles and coos that one day become ma-ma, da-da and I love you. Besides being music to your ears, these baby steps of language change everything as your little one discovers an exciting, powerful new way of relating to the world! Baby's First Sounds invites both of you to share these memorable moments: those precious ''firsts'' that come around once in your baby's lifetime.

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Love - EP120
programme.desc: In this episode, we will learn about the value of love. We will understand that when we have love in our hearts, we care about the well-being of others, so we make them happy. Pets must also be treated with love and respect. The first step to accepting that we are unique is by loving ourselves. Respect is a big part of love and when love is in our heart, there is no place for negative feelings.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The castle of Robins
programme.desc: Since the lens fails to be recovered, Dr. No wants to make another, but he needs robins to make it. So he attacks Rubidia, a region filled with different precious stones. But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. But the boy gets the scientist falls into a trap and also helps free the slaves of Rubidia.

The antimatters are near and Chip asked the musician to prepare the trap to retain them and escape. The musician agrees and the antimatters are prisoners of the musician that makes them hear the terrible sound of his compositions.

programme.desc: The Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind a cupboard... it's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: The Black Lizard
programme.desc: Young swordsman Lung Fei encounters strange omens portending the death of his fiance. His enquiries with the help of Chief Constable Tieh Hu reveal an astounding story, in this tale of men and women struggling to save their true loves.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancee Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: The film is about a Chinese martial arts school finds itself outclassed by their rivals, they hire elite ninja from Japan to destroy the school. The lone survivor of the massacre learns the secrets of ninjutsu and seeks revenge against the ninja.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70's Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage. A heartless tycoon plans to take over the orphanage for its land but has to deal with Seventh Sister's magical powers as she aims to protect it from falling into his hands!

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy "House of 72 tenants", this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world...

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: The Shaolin Avengers
programme.desc: Hu seeks to avenge his father who is being killed by the White-Browed Hermit and his gang. However, he fails in his attempt and is saved by Fang Shi Yu, a youth from Shaolin whose parents are also killed by the same villains. They learn and master the advanced Shaolin style kung fu, before Fang leads Hu and the Shaolin fellows to fight the enemies.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Jade Faced Assassin
programme.desc: Two forbidden lovers, Zhang Zhen and Yue Nu, are killed by four villains and left behind their twin babies. Yue Nu's elder sister hopes to restore the clan's honour and separates the twins, arranging for them to be raised by competing clans. 18 years later, the twins meet and fight against each other, bringing chaos to the martial arts world.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo by turning them against him. Will good prevail over evil?

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: Sima works for a corrupt lord Qin who is suffering from a deadly disease that only a special herb can cure. Qin sends him on an urgent mission to retrieve it, but the task is made more difficult when Sima has to fight off other martial artists who want to steal the cure away from him. He has to fight with his ultimate weapon, the Dragon Missile!

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword and The Kung-fu Instructor as one of his very best.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his master's rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gao's betrayal...

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from "Nine Yang Scriptures" by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more than a gambling film, this is a thrilling melting pot of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, poker-face vengeance, and all sorts of edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more than a gambling film, this is a thrilling melting pot of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, poker-face vengeance, and all sorts of edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Kung Fu legend Ti Lung stars in the action movie as Fu Xue Hong, embarking on a epic journey of revenge for his father.

programme.title: Portrait In Crystal
programme.desc: Tragic deaths in the underworld cause leader "Yama" (Teng Wei-hao) to suspect a portrait in crystal with mysterious powers. He sends Hen Pan (Chen Hung) and Pai Pan (Hung Hsin-nan) to interrogate its creator, martial artist Lung Fei (Pai Piao)...

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: Cat VS Rat
programme.desc: Zhan and Bai are equally matched in martial arts skills. Bai saves the Emperor one day but did not believe in his identity and rejects a promotion. When Zhan is promoted to the royal guard after saving the Emperor, Bai gets angry and tries to prank him by stealing the imperial jade seal. Luckily, Zhan is able to retrieve the seal with his skills.

programme.title: Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: Wang Chung was a valued actor long before he became a director, but as a filmmaker, he helped create some of the most interesting thrillers Shaw Brothers ever released - including this fascinating crime saga of a Sino-Vietnamese crime gang. Danny Lee stars as a misunderstood refugee while Ray Lui plays a cop struggling against his own conscience to ensure that justice is upheld.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Third Master is a renowned swordsman in the martial arts world, but the constant challenges by other swordsmen compel him to fake his death and pursue a secluded life. This does not prevent others from seeking him out to challenge him however, and he is forced to return to fight his way till the end.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: My Rebellious Son
programme.desc: A corrupt official attempts to steal a priceless Buddha statue from a temple to please a group of Westerners. Luckily, Doctor Zhang and his son manage to defeat the Western boxers, the Japanese Kendo opponents and the Western longsword fighters with Chinese kung fu, thus saving the Buddha statue.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: 2026 CMG Spring Festival Evening Gala
programme.desc: Stay tuned to CCTV-4 as we introduce you to the various content and programming on the channel.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Impermanence
programme.desc: A series of strange events is happening in a peaceful village, including a corpse that is resurrected from its grave and ran away. As the villagers investigate, a villain dies and the village head also goes missing. Police investigation ensues, but as the truths start to unveil, more mysteries are unfolding. Who is the one behind them all?

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather’s fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: Nightmare of Darkness
programme.desc: A young actress’ Weibo account is refreshed with a new post three years after her death, disclosing her dating picture with young idol Wu Zi Zhen. Wu seeks help from the PR consultant Qiao Shen at his haunted house, but encounters a series of horrifying incidents. After being interrogated by Qiao, Wu lowers his guard and unveils a shocking secret...

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters’ best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong’s biggest stars

programme.title: Deep in the Sea
programme.desc: Suspended psychiatrist Huang is asked to treat Zhao who suffers from schizophrenia. Zhao can only release himself from the pain of his girlfriend's death by killing people in his delusion. During the treatment, Huang is gradually affected by Zhao. He soon finds the way to cure Zhao, but then discovers an important secret about himself.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man’s father hires him to take care of her. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Claire And Present Danger
programme.desc: Jims Trollhunting life and his high school life collide when Claire becomes a target for Goblin revenge.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - The Battle Of Two Bridges
programme.desc: Jim must surrender to Bular and unlock the Killahead Bridge to save kidnapped Blinky and promises Claire that he will get her brother back.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Bem-Vindo ao Rio
programme.desc: After losing their mission materials in quicksand, Tony decides to channel Dom and Blend in to get intel from the people of Rio. Unfortunately it's more difficult than he expected, and Tony and his crew are picked up by a group of favela gangsters in a neighborhood that worships a mysterious young female martyr. The crew is relieved to find that Layla is in charge of the gangsters - until she orders the gangsters to dispose of them!

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Combustion
programme.desc: Tony is convinced that Layla is deep undercover and tries to talk to her alone to get through to her. Meanwhile, the crew investigates the gang’s production of the mysterious formula from the tattoo. When Frostee discovers that the product of the formula is unstable and will explode, Tony has to save Layla, who is driving a whole truck of it!

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Driving Blind
programme.desc: Now broken out of mind control, Layla goes undercover with the gang, hiding the fact that she’s no longer being controlled. The crew is shocked to discover that revered martyr Rafaela Moreno is still alive and is the mastermind behind the mind control plot. Rafaela puts Layla’s driving to the test in a wild race against a mystery driver, then takes the rest of the crew hostage just days before Rafaela's dastardly plot.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - The Fast and the Friendliest Much Achoo About Nothing
programme.desc: Branch is training Keith for the big Flyer Bug Race, but he gets too caught up in his competition with Creek and his protégé. When it appears Mr. Dinkles has developed an allergy to Biggie, Biggie must find a solution fast.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - The S. S. Friend-ship
programme.desc: After the PALs encourage Maricela to make new friends, she forms the exclusive "Poshy Posse" with Priya, Sahir and Alex.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S3 - The Way Forward
programme.desc: Captured and confused, the Paladins are interrogated about where they have been and what happened to Lotor

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - The Big Flap
programme.desc: Liam drives his cousin, then his other two podmates nuts when he refuses to let any of them know what's in the mysterious box he's been carrying around. When school newspaper editor Jason Ablinsky gets the mix, the fear of public exposure hikes the stakes and the race is on. And no one has ANY idea what Liam's carrying.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Finding Neko
programme.desc: Birch's cat Neko disappears on Liam's watch. Realizing that finding the AWOL feline is too big a job for just one guy, Liam has to convince a reluctant Sandra and Raffi. Liam is afraid that failure to locate the kitty escape artist will mean facing his cousin's eternal wrath.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - The Raffi Raffle
programme.desc: The girls "steal" Liam's fundraising to raffle off Raffi. Unfortunately, Principal Lemmon, who hates anything remotely fun is on Birch and Sandra's trail as the two girls try to pull off a successful fundraiser and complete part of their civics studies.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Crushed
programme.desc: An unsigned note puts Birch into detective mode. With Sandra standing by to ridicule her, Birch tries to lure her shy admirer into the open. Will the guy secretly crushing on Birch be revealed or will Sandra get the last laugh?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Buttercup Bad Wolf
programme.desc: The twins are playing "The Three Little Pigs". Buttercup is enjoying her role as the big bad wolf rather too much and scares poor Daisy. Will Buttercup realise how upset her sister is?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - When The Sky Cried
programme.desc: Buttercup and Daisy decide that it only rains when the sky is upset. They set about trying to cheer the sky up

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - My Fair Bumble
programme.desc: Bumble has been asked to Aunt Tulip's for tea but he is worried that his manners are not up to scratch. He asks the other tots to help him out.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Pineapple Palace Panic
programme.desc: Fifi is supposed to be babysitting Grubby, but she's forgotten! Stingo and Slugsy step in to cover for her, with disastrous results!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Poppy's Big Race
programme.desc: It is the day of the annual Flowertot Race. Poppy is reluctant to enter as she always loses her way. Fifi and Bumble help her train for the big race, but will she win?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Blueberry Hunt
programme.desc: Fifi and Bumble are off to pick all the ripe blueberries off the bush. But when they get there all the berries have disappeared. Who could have taken them?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Snowtime For Pip
programme.desc: All Pip wants to do is play in the snow. Fifi tries to help him out, and come up with a brilliant idea how they can without it actually snowing!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Pip And The Wizard
programme.desc: Stingo and Slugsy put on a magic show. But will anybody find out that he is a fraud?

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Runs A Carnival
programme.desc: When Mrs. Hogenmuller's class plans a Parents' Night, Olivia thrills her classmates when she suggests the idea of a carnival. In her own special way Olivia oversees the construction of games and amusements, and when the night of the carnival arrives, she still has a few surprises up her sleeve.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Makes Magic
programme.desc: After seeing Grandma perform an impromptu magic show, Olivia begins practicing her own magic tricks. She doesn't have much success, until she manages to make herself "disappear" for Ian and Julian. They can't figure out how she's done it, but Ian doesn't care. He just wants his big sister back!

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Summer Holiday
programme.desc: In need of some rest and relaxation, the Riders head out on vacation. But their supposedly perfect island getaway isn't quite what they hoped for.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - A New Bergen-Ning Laugh Out Cloud
programme.desc: Poppy throws a party to urge the Trolls and Bergens to build friendship When Troll Village has a drought Cloud Guy offers to wash away the problem after some quality time with Branch.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Two Party System Fun Branch
programme.desc: Poppy discovers that Branch and Bridgets birthdays are on the same day and throws them both partiesBranch attempts to prove to the Snack Pack that he is fun.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - Queen Of Police Roidian Prom

programme.title: Golden City (Ep 801-850) VVD Mandarin EP.824 - EP824
programme.desc: Set in the 60s in Jioufen, the story tells how three sworn brothers conquer the world with their bare hands. While connecting romance from the previous generation to the shared emotions with the present, the drama explores differences in generational values.

She has a splitting headache. After taking some painkiller, she drives to see some client but runs into some porcelain crash for cash scammer.

programme.title: Heroes In White EP.2 - EP2

Wing-sum gets anxious and assaults Wai-man. But Wai-man saves her while she falls down. Wai-man’s identity is revealed as he appears on TV for his involvement in cracking down on fake medicinal oil.

programme.title: Heroes In White EP.3 - EP3

programme.title: Heroes In White EP.4 - EP4

After finding out Wai-man’s predicament, Shuk-foon wants to use her Yam Yuen Pharmaceutical Company dividends to help him. But Wai-man declines.

programme.title: The Loud House S8 - Karaless Whisper Dollars and Scents

programme.title: The Loud House S8 - Bulking and Sulking Wild Goss Chase

programme.title: The Loud House S8 - Trouble Brewing The Cling and I

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover S2 - The Max of Life
programme.desc: Missing fame and fans, Max decides to recapture some glory by breaking Booch's sandwich-stacking record at Splat by the Sea, but Chloe challenges him so that her friend can have her record back.

programme.title: Danger Force S2 - Bottle Snatchers
programme.desc: After Danger Force thwarts a robbery at Club Soda and has a legendary night celebrating their win, Ray challenges the kids to repeat their epic night out without their superhero uniforms and powers.

programme.title: Danger Force S2 - The Girl Who Cried Danger
programme.desc: Volt and ShoutOut hatch a plan to stop their super-clinger fan from making false alarm emergency calls.

programme.title: Henry Danger S5 - Henry's Birthday
programme.desc: While trying to celebrate his birthday, Henry keeps getting interrupted by crimes going on in Swellview.

programme.title: Henry Danger S5 - Whistlin' Susie

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S2 - The Rejects

programme.title: The Loud House S5 - Hurl, Interrupted Diamonds are for Never

programme.title: The Loud House S6 - Flip This Flip Haunted House Call

programme.title: The Loud House S4 - Face the Music with the Casagrandes

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - Meats of Strength Dead Ed's

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP28
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: Golden Bowl - EP6
programme.desc: Man’s Noodles is passed down to the current generation. Man Shui (Raymond Cho), Man Nin (Hugo Wong) and Man Sai (Mark Ma) have learned the craft from their father and opened their own noodle shops. However, three shops on the same street have resulted in destructive competition. Lung Kau (Mayanne Mak), Fok Siu-yuk (Ashley Chu) and Kam Chi (Kamen Kong) are their wives respectively. They often quarrel as they earnestly defend their husbands.

programme.title: The Runner - EP8
programme.desc: Web media editor Ho Ka-yan (Elaine Yiu) encounters track and field coach Yuen Nik (Joel Chan) as she is assigned the task of approaching the Windchasers Club and digging up scandalous dirt. Because of some past regrettable incident, Yuen Nik avoids socializing with other people. But he is getting closer and closer to Ka-yan as he repeatedly mingles with her. Kwok Bui-yee (Tiffany Lau), daughter of tycoon Kwok Wong-po (Ram Chiang), eagerly joins Windchasers as she has some ulterior motive.

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP34
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: Law dis-Order - EP6
programme.desc: As the founder of the leading Chinese law firm, CHEUK KAI-YIU (Lau Dan) has been re-elected as chairman of the committee for many terms. Though he promised managing partner LAU KING-CHANG (Liu Kai Chi) that he would step down, he deliberately brings in a materialistic lawyer called CHEUNG KEUNG (Alex Fong) to counterbalance KING-CHANG's obsession with power.

programme.title: The Silver Chamber Of Sorrows - EP2
programme.desc: "Sheung’s Silver Chamber", the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. In order to obtain a loan from SHUM’s family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG’s younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM’s family.

programme.title: Hello Missfortune - EP7
programme.desc: In a multidimensional domain, Poon Siu-yu (Erica Chan) enters the second dimension after her death in the first dimension, i.e. the mortal realm. She then joins Office of the Life Authority and becomes a novice "destiny administrator". Siu-yu has to keep a close watch on food courier Chan Pei-ho (Hubert Wu), who is in the mortal realm. Pei-ho earns a meager living regardless of the weather. But his family members just do not care about him.

programme.title: Pages Of Treasures - EP10
programme.desc: Bookshop staff FONG HOK MAN (Chun Pui) always believes that "knowledge is power". He tries hard to encourage his older son FONG SUM MING (Lai Yiu Cheung) and his younger son FONG SUM CHING (Suen Eric) to study more. Unfortunately, MING is not good at studying at all and he quits after secondary school. On the other hand, CHING is a very smart boy and MING works hard overseas to support CHING’s further studies on computer sciences in America.

programme.title: 人间新闻
programme.desc: 人间卫视不同于其他电视台定位，一向致力于打造媒体新视野，并期许为新闻界注入一股清流。《人间新闻》此次改版，将再提升新闻品质与水准，落实公益电视台的媒体责任。《人间新闻》报导的焦点包含慈善公益、社会关怀、文化艺术、人文教育、心灵提升、健康医疗、环保议题等内容，借由这些新闻与专题报导，将传递真善美的人间清流，提供观众更广阔的新闻视野，与世界脉动接轨。

programme.title: 名人书房第83集
programme.desc: 阅读引导我们漫步在别人的思想与灵魂当中13位名人的读书故事，13段动人的奇幻旅程~继2015年与中天电视合作制播《名人床头书》节目，邀请39位名人深度分享阅读带来的影响及美好，冠德玉山教育基金会于2018年起独立制作《名人书房》影片，以阅读为主题的实景记录，期待能呈现文学、艺术、设计、空间等风格意义，邀请王伟忠、五月天/石头、江坤俊、姚谦、郎祖筠、许芳宜、郭重兴、曾文诚、曾宝仪、郑丰、徐薇X大成、刘安婷X吕冠纬等跨界名人，由资深主播詹庆龄担任主持人，在漫漫的引言互动中，侃侃而谈对生命的感知、阅读经验的分享与追梦的过程。影片片头「名人书房」由《每日一字》书法家张炳煌挥毫，配乐为大提琴家吕超伦演奏

programme.title: 唐奖纪录片第24集

programme.desc: 《百年巨匠》是一部大规模、全方位拍摄制作的关于近代艺术大师、画坛巨匠的大型人物传记系列纪录片，用独特的影视镜头语言对20世纪中国画坛上最具影响力的艺术巨匠进行的全方位的影像解读和人物诠释。动人心弦、精彩纷呈的人物故事，再现了一代艺术大师真实生动、极富传奇色彩的人生历程。故事起伏跌宕，感人至深，具有不可多得的文献价值和赏心悦目的审美价值。

programme.title: 美丽人生壮志高飞第423集
programme.desc: 台视60周年台庆大戏《美丽人生》第五单元《壮志高飞》，以1960年代高雄市旗津岛为故事起点，三位最美丽的台湾女人，在台湾最美丽的年代，在最美丽的旗津，悲欢交织而成的美丽人生。数百年前，旗津还没有一个统一的名称，岛的南端依旧与高雄相连。 而后，为了建造高雄港第二港口，旗津南端名唤『崩隙』的这片沙土挖空了，居民被迫迁移，旗津也因而断开 了与台湾的连系，犹如游子，离开了母亲的怀抱。土地会消失，历史也许会被淡忘，但曾经走过那段艰辛岁月的人们，他们的悲欢离合、笑容与泪水，仍将会转化为孕育后代子孙的养分，开出灿烂的花朵。这是属于我们上一代人的故事，也是我们这一代人的故事，是所有在这座岛屿上奋斗的人们的—《

programme.title: 热海恋歌第28集
programme.desc: 父母亲早逝的英雄，从小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次乡里冲突，英雄和换帖兄弟添财离家北上，进入温泉乡~北投，当起限时专送的机车小弟。在北投，他遇见今生唯一的挚爱秀秀。拥有天生音乐才华的他，最初学习各种乐器只是为了讨秀秀欢心，最后却因此成为名扬北投的「春风」那卡西乐团乐手。可惜两人纯真的恋情，却遭秀秀的养父所反对，英雄却不放弃；纵使在得知秀秀已与日本商人白原订婚之后，英雄仍不死心，继续穿梭在温泉乡崎岖的巷道与繁华的酒宴间，弹著为秀秀所谱写的未完成歌曲，无畏地向全世界宣誓，他要倾尽一生的光阴来爱秀秀…。在秀秀与白元的婚礼上，英雄冲到美川阁，想带秀秀远走高飞！毕竟深爱著英雄的秀秀，身著婚纱、不顾一切坐上他

programme.desc: 在家乡玉里服务一辈子的老师「杨招治」 人生幸福组的她却在年过半百时，失去挚爱的丈夫，面临退休与否的抉择。 「人生只能这样吗？」招治问自己。她想起家中的三老，她看见生活周遭需要帮助的灵魂，那些需要触动了招治最温柔的一块心田，她知道，她的人生可以不只是这样…

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第10集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 映照人生第490集
programme.desc: 印尼，是个超过两亿人口的东南亚大国，贫富差距极大，且语言文化种族差异均大。由印尼大爱台制作的「映照人生」，报导当地各面向的社会议题，从2010年起逐年获奖，被誉为是印尼正面纪录片的先驱之一。 制作团队都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地观点，对印尼社会做深度观察，发现问题，报导当事人如何解决或面对，制作出一系列感人且启发人心的故事，传达以人道为关怀精神的节目内容。 本节目记录著印尼底层的人们，每个勇敢迎向苦难与希望的故事；也带领观众看见，这个世界的黑暗角落，因为人性的光辉，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 法华经序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法华经序系花莲静思精舍，于每日拂晓时分，僧俗二众的早课实录，意在启发自性本具的大乘精神；旨于引导大众常行菩萨道。除心无旁骛专注于当下课诵的经文外，同时扩及日常生活每一刻的专注、培养慈悲佛心，学习缩小自我，破我执，达到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 证严上人说故事第268集
programme.desc: 听故事，曾经是儿时最大的期待。好听的故事，更是百听不厌、刻骨铭心。 《证严上人说故事》是证严上人从多年生活历练中摘取得来的智慧结晶。在一则则风趣浅白故事中，她告诉我们，在生命的经营里，如果被『名』枷『利』锁绑住，而失去心灵空间，那将是一种无法弥补的损失。

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第15集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大马慈济情第682集

programme.title: 法华经序HD中文版第1集

programme.title: 孩子看世界第100集
programme.desc: 孩子看世界，看世界孩子的故事！在世界每一个角落，每天都上演著不同孩子的故事。节目透过各个国家真实发生过的事件，让小朋友看见多元文化、懂得见苦知福，培养同理心，利用三张图片激发孩子的想像力，编织一个故事。根据节目主题扣合地球永续发展目标，提出问题，让孩子进行思考、探究，触动好奇、展开对话。

programme.title: 蔬果生活志第37集
programme.desc: 关于「吃」，该怎么吃得有智慧、吃出健康和营养呢？ 了解台湾不同时节、气候的丰富物产，透过农人的智慧和汗水，告诉您食材的生命故事，并且体验背后的价值与感动。

programme.title: 大爱真健康第1084集
programme.desc: 运动是对自己最好的投资，不只是为了瘦身、增肌，是为了更好的生活品质，每一天做一件对自己好的事，日子就会很踏实。 运动是一辈子的事，没时间运动不是借口，每天花三~五分钟时间，跟著「大爱真健康」做运动，让你愈动愈年轻、愈动愈健康！

programme.title: 大爱学汉医第520集
programme.desc: 让世界看懂中医，打破中医的框架迷思，发挥预防重于治疗的优点，让台湾走向乐活社会。

programme.title: 365日日素第236集

programme.title: 大爱夜安新闻 LIVE
programme.desc: 证严上人慈示：「新闻报导，除了『报』，还要进一步『导』，范畴要开阔，关怀普天下苍民，为时代作见证，为人类写历史。」，大爱新闻透过SNG、电话连线、数位影像，传递全球最新讯息，坚持将人间美善讯息与人性光明面的故事至散播世界各地，发挥净化人心功能。

programme.title: 同学早安第5集
programme.desc: 在家乡玉里服务一辈子的老师「杨招治」 人生幸福组的她却在年过半百时，失去挚爱的丈夫，面临退休与否的抉择。 「人生只能这样吗？」招治问自己。她想起家中的三老，她看见生活周遭需要帮助的灵魂，那些需要触动了招治最温柔的一块心田，她知道，她的人生可以不只是这样…

programme.title: 大爱医生馆第6734集
programme.desc: 不断汲取新知，已是现代人必备的条件，对于人文精神的掌握，往往显得贫乏。大爱医生馆借由医师专业知识加上俯拾即是的美感经验与与回归人文思想的本怀，期望帮助忙碌的现代人多关心自己与周遭人的身心健康，为医疗节目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第618集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陆寻奇第1932集
programme.desc: 大陆寻奇是台湾目前最社教节目之冠不惜巨资的大制作足迹踏遍各现代城市、穷乡僻壤，深入各民族村落，记录了外人难得一见的生活情况，以准确的地理、历史定位，用现代化思维，把中华文化忠实的呈现。 漫游在浩瀚中国的世外桃源，细赏湖光山色间的粉妆玉琢，带您跋山涉水游遍奇峰峻岭，让您看尽壮阔山河叹为观止。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子第6季:第402集
programme.desc: 本作品是以作者的童年（昭和49年，即1974年）生活为蓝本的故事，其中一事一物均充满著1970年代的怀旧气息。故事发生的舞台是日本静冈县清水市，那是一个不折不扣的美丽港都，是个交通便利、渔产丰富、又与富士山为邻的好地方。故事围绕著小丸子以及其家人和同学展开，有关于亲情、友谊等，或是一些生活小事，但当中有笑有泪，令人回想起童年的稚气。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子第5季:第340集
programme.desc: 故事的主角是小丸子及其家人和同学，故事内容涵盖了亲情、友谊等主题，以及一些生活中的小事情。这些故事中既有欢笑，也有泪水，让人回想起童年时的天真无邪。

programme.title: 大陆寻奇第2071集
programme.desc: 大陆寻奇是台湾目前最社教节目之冠不惜巨资的大制作足迹踏遍各现代城市、穷乡僻壤，深入各民族村落，记录了外人难得一见的生活情况，以准确的地理、历史定位，用现代化思维，把中华文化忠实的呈现。 漫游在浩瀚中国的世外桃源，细赏湖光山色间的粉妆玉琢，带您跋山涉水游遍奇峰峻岭，让您看尽壮阔山河叹为观止。

programme.title: 难哄第31集
programme.desc: 温以凡和高中时的暧昧对象意外重逢，两人阴错阳差成为室友，复杂难解的情愫也再度萌芽。

programme.title: 全民星攻略第1155集
programme.desc: 中视推出悬疑益智实境节目《全民星攻略》！由幽默风趣「慧黠」的《馆长》-曾国城，引领明星、名人、网红，全民进击「九宫格攻略赛」，过关夺大奖！ 最悬疑紧张的过关氛围、最诙谐爆笑的「尔虞我诈」 ！最贴近「人生」的智慧题库！敬请准时一起来挑战-《全民星攻略》！

programme.title: 中视午间新闻第20集
programme.desc: 「中视午间新闻」每天以最客观的角度，最专业的主播，为观众完整报导上午发生之重大国内外重要新闻，并提供最新股市收盘价格。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第793集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 庆余年第1集
programme.desc: 某大学文学史专业的学生张庆（张若昀饰）熟读古典名著，但他用现代观念剖析古代文学史，透过写小说的方式，进一步阐述自己想要表达的观点。在他的小说中，身世神秘的少年范闲，自小跟随奶奶生活在海边小城澹州，随著一位自称老师的突然造访，他看似平静的生活开始直面重重的危机与考验。上半部的剧情主要发生在京都，范闲追查牛栏街刺杀一案的幕后黑手。下半部剧情发生在北齐上京城，范闲亲率南庆使团，前往北齐用战犯肖恩交换言冰云。但这只是，庆帝和陈萍萍布局，想令肖恩误以为范闲就是他失散多年的孙子，借此套出神庙的秘密。

programme.title: 三生三世十里桃花第57集
programme.desc: 同名小说改编。青丘九尾狐族女君白浅（杨幂）为四海八荒第一绝色，化名司音拜入战神墨渊（赵又廷）门下，因而卷入天族与翼族之战。在墨渊封印东皇钟七万年后，白浅代师再次封印东皇钟而受伤，失去记忆与修为落入凡尘历劫，却因此变成凡人素素，与天族太子夜华（赵又廷）历经三生三世的情缘…

programme.title: 包青天第14集
programme.desc: 包拯为北宋仁宗天圣五年（1027年）申科进士甲科，初任建昌知县，官至开封府尹及龙图阁大学士，这跟电视上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中国清官的典型代表，后世包括朱熹、欧阳修、司马光对他都有正面评价。宋仁宗年间，开封府尹包拯，通称「包青天」。为官清廉，为民伸冤，强调「人在做天在看」、「举头三尺有神明」不畏强权，除恶务尽。较脍炙人口的单元有「秦香莲」、「真假状元」、「貍猫换太子」等。

programme.desc: 包拯为北宋仁宗天圣五年（1027年）申科进士甲科，初任建昌知县，官至开封府尹及龙图阁大学士，这跟电视上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中国清官的典型代表，后世包括朱熹、欧阳修、司马光对他都有正面评价。宋仁宗年间，开封府尹包拯，通称「包青天」。为官清廉，为民伸冤，强调「人在做天在看」、「举头三尺有神明」不畏强权，除恶务尽。较脍炙人口的单元有「秦香莲」、「真假状元」、「貍猫换太子」等。

programme.desc: 自2005年开播以来，《真情部落格》已访问数百位生命勇士。当这些勇士面对生命中的困难时，他们选择依靠对耶稣的信心，勇敢地克服挑战。这些可爱的基督徒愿意与大家分享他们生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是将来自天上的美好福分带给人们。每一个充满血泪的生命见证都是令人震撼的转变，带来最深刻的真实感。

programme.title: 神选之人第31集
programme.desc: 本剧以精湛的演技与紧凑无冷场的剧情吸引全球观众目光，成功掀起追剧热潮并赢得广大口碑。透过沉浸式的叙事手法，带领观众走进圣经时代的场景与人物互动，同时呈现一位真实、贴近且富有人性光辉的耶稣，使人们在观赏故事的过程中获得全新的理解与感动。

programme.title: 神选之人第32集

programme.title: 艺术二分之一-Art kak’I’iyaeh第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 《艺术二分之一：Art kak’i’iyaeh》以原住民族群的生活样貌，引导观众重新认识我们与自然之间的深厚联系。节目以元素为主题，解锁新兴样貌的原住民艺术家，展现如何从土地中取得灵感并将其转化为多元族群的艺术形式。艺术的一半来自创作，另一半则透过观众的感受与诠释得以完整，体现艺术共享的精神，同时展现永续与共生的创作理念。

programme.title: 当昼新闻第50集
